# CI Test Fixtures

> **Tag:** `[GATE]` · Generated by `npm run fixtures:ci`

This folder holds **8 synthetic JPEGs** for GitHub Actions and headless E2E when the elite workspace photos are not present (gitignored).

## Generate locally

```bash
npm run fixtures:ci              # → test/fixtures/ci-photos/
npm run fixtures:ci -- --workspace  # also copy to photos for use/
```

## CI usage

GitHub Actions runs `fixtures:ci --workspace` before `test:e2e` so workspace scan and export tests have input photos without committing user JPGs.
